[USER] The user asked about the average cost of getting jewelry appraised and insured and any additional fees.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that appraisal costs vary based on type and complexity of the jewelry, appraisal method, appraiser's expertise, location, and insurance coverage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided general estimates for jewelry appraisal costs:  
- Verbal appraisal: $25-$100  
- Written appraisal: $50-$500  
- Detailed appraisal report: $100-$2,000  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided estimates for insurance premiums:  
- Annual premium: 1.5% to 3% of the item's value  
- Deductible: $0 to $1,000  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed additional fees to be aware of: reappraisal fees, update fees, shipping and handling fees, policy administration fees, commission fees.
